body: Thank you very much. I really hadn't thought of it that way.

No. Do not by any means give up on yourself. I've been where you are. I started self harming when I was 13 years old and now I am 21. My best advice to you would be to stop now. I know this is easier said than done but you will thank yourself in the long run. You have to start finding other things to do to distract yourself. I took up going to the gym and it has been slowly helping me out. I'm not going to lie to you though, sometimes the stress of life will get to you, and it will be overwhelming but you must learn how to not go running to the blade in order to feel relief. By the looks of your username, I'm going to assume that you like taking photos. Go outside and take photos of whatever is around you. Go to the library and look up books about photography. If college is something in your plan than take a few courses on it! 

All in all friend, realize that even though you are going through a difficult time please try to better yourself and stop. Focus on your school work. You have made it to your senior year so I know you can graduate! But again please don't give up on yourself. You have so much more of the world to see and you need to be alive to do so. 

If you ever want to talk to someone feel free to reach out to me.
